page.title: Printers
page.description: Network ESC/POS thermal printers (Wi-Fi or Ethernet) for non-fiscal receipts and cash closings, and for daily tickets once the daily sale is live: address, paper width, cut, cash drawer, routing per cash register and test print. Available with the desktop app.

unavailable.title: ESC/POS printing is available with the desktop app
unavailable.description: Network thermal printers work when Arenile runs on the establishment's computer (desktop app, LAN mode included), because it must reach the printer on the beach network. On this installation the cash closing prints from the browser; non-fiscal receipts need the desktop app with a thermal printer.

list.title: Configured printers
list.description: ESC/POS printers reachable on the local network (TCP port 9100). Check tests the connection without printing.
list.emptyHint: Add the printer with its IP address: you find it on the self-test slip (hold FEED while switching on) or in the router's device list.
list.emptyServer: With the desktop app you can connect Wi-Fi or Ethernet thermal printers.

form.description: ESC/POS thermal printer on the beach network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet).

fields.name: Name
fields.hostHint: Local network addresses only (e.g. 192.168.1.50). Tip: give the printer a fixed IP in the router.
fields.charsPerLineHint: 32 for 58 mm paper, 48 for 80 mm paper (font A).
fields.codepageHint: CP858 prints € and accented letters on almost every printer.
fields.codepageTableHint: Leave empty for the standard Epson value; some printers use different numbers (see the manual).
fields.drawerHint: Connected to the printer with the RJ11 cable: opens at the end of the print when the rule says so.
fields.printLogoHint: The establishment logo, converted to black and white for thermal paper.
fields.activeHint: An inactive printer receives no prints: documents go to the browser.

delete.message: Printer {{name}} and its routing rules will be deleted; queued prints will be cancelled.

validation.hostPublic: Only local network addresses are allowed (e.g. 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x)
validation.nameTaken: A printer with this name already exists
validation.duplicateRoute: There is already a rule for this document and register

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: Which printer prints each document. A rule for one register wins over the rule for all registers; without a rule the document prints from the browser.
routing.emptyHint: Add a rule to print cash closings and receipts on the thermal printer.

jobs.title: Latest prints
jobs.description: Failed prints are retried automatically (5 s, 15 s, 1 min, 5 min); then you can retry by hand.

problem.printing_unavailable: ESC/POS printing is available only with the desktop app.
problem.printer_address_not_allowed: The printer address is not on the local network.
problem.print_route_missing: No printer is configured for this document.

fallback.title: Printing from the browser
fallback.server_edition: The thermal printer is used with the desktop app.
fallback.no_route: No thermal printer is configured for this document.
fallback.printer_unreachable: The thermal printer does not answer: check that it is on and connected.
fallback.error: The thermal printer could not be contacted.

hint.title: Thermal printers
hint.description: With the desktop app Arenile prints non-fiscal receipts and cash closings (and daily tickets once the daily sale is live) on the beach's Wi-Fi or Ethernet ESC/POS printers.
